The petitioner is languishing in custody in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 342, 354, 376(D)(A), 504, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4/6/8 of the POCSO Act.
It is a case of commission of kidnapping and rape to the minor daughter of the informant.
